## Why

Later notes from the S145 relay (run-20261026-143702-868c, landed 8641c82), not fixed in that slice:
- Line 2 styling (UI pass, round 3): the title is dim like the output and the ": " separator doubles up ("Forty-one untitled: round 2: rerunning the checks"). Suggested: title in the default foreground, two spaces between title and output, only the output dim or amber, so a denial no longer colours the title.
- At 80x24 a long title eats line 2; clip the title to about 24 columns when the output would get under about 20.
- The regex in stripTaskLabel is compiled on every render.
- docs/dashboard.md lists the task-label separators but omits "/".
- On the selected row a denial loses its amber cue, and line 2 is bold as well as reversed.
- Error rows keep the old one-line form.
- An engine run and a ledger run of the same slice look alike.
- With parallel roles only the last open role shows, and an engine run's tail may belong to another role.
- The scroll bump may hide line 1 at the smallest body heights (internal/tui/view.go).
- `ork status` still prints the old running:/failed: text.
- The sidebar Running entry (S110) stays one line and only gets the round word.
- Ledger-only round counts wait on slicer labelling the finish step (note on slicer s392).
